subject: System Design
title: Designing for Failure
description: A quick win: understand Designing for Failure.

hook.text: Netflix intentionally kills random servers in production. They call it Chaos Monkey.

buildup.text: In distributed systems, failures are inevitable. Designing for failure means assuming things will break.

discovery.text: Timeouts, retries, circuit breakers, and fallbacks keep the system running when parts fail.

twist.text: Systems that never fail in testing fail catastrophically in production. Chaos engineering prevents surprises.

climax.text: Resilient systems don't prevent failures — they survive them gracefully and recover automatically.

punchline.text: Don't prevent failure — survive it gracefully.

quiz.question: What is Netflix's Chaos Monkey?
options: A tool that intentionally kills random servers in production
